service-call.name: org.moqui.comms.MailSettingsServices.store#OutOfOffice

if.message: ${enabled == 'Y' ? (storeOut.storedCount > 1 ? 'Automatic reply saved on ' + storeOut.storedCount + ' accounts' : 'Automatic reply saved') : 'Automatic reply off'}

actions.script: oooAccounts = Array.from(oooOut?.accountList || []) hasAccounts = oooAccounts.length > 0 selectedAccountId = oooOut?.selectedAccountId || null // Date objects cross the script boundary as Timestamps for Standard/TUI formatting; static QVT receives epoch text. const dates = oooOut?.replyTimestamps || {} replyForm = Object.assign({}, oooOut?.reply || {}, { fromDate: dates.fromDate == null ? null : new Date(Number(dates.fromDate)), thruDate: dates.thruDate == null ? null : new Date(Number(dates.thruDate)) }) statusText = oooOut?.statusText || '' isActive = oooOut?.isActive === true hasServer = oooOut?.hasServer === true selectedAccount = oooAccounts.find((account) => account.emailAccountId === selectedAccountId) || null manyAccounts = oooAccounts.length > 1

label.text: An automatic reply to the people who write while you are away. Each sender gets it once every few days; mailing lists, newsletters, other automatic replies and spam get nothing.
Add a mail account first: the automatic reply goes out from it.
This account has no server, so no reply can go out from it.

default-field.title: Until
default-field.tooltip: Empty: until you turn it off

default-field.title: Subject
default-field.tooltip: Empty: Automatic reply: and the subject of their mail

default-field.title: For people inside the organization
default-field.tooltip: Empty: they get the message above

default-field.title: Reply to each sender once every

option.text: My contacts and people inside the organization

default-field.title: Other domains inside the organization
default-field.tooltip: Separated by commas, such as example.org, example.net: people who write from these domains get the message for people inside

option.text: The same reply on all my accounts

label.text: Your contacts are the people your address book knows, when this system has one. People inside the organization are the system's users and addresses at the domains of your shared accounts and the other domains you list. Turning the reply on again sends it to everyone again.
